answer: Where did the whisper come from? Who painted the yarrow? When was the walnut finished? The farm answers the first two and chokes on the third. The record only grows longer, and a mask that turns up twice is caught by its own echo. One proof settles it, and it reads Pewter inspector alloy mark poured at the cooling rack, spelled out in full as each alloy is a pouring record witnessed by the master pewterer. Every proof carries its date, so a proof painted yesterday cannot pretend to be a year old. Lock 165 POA away per mask and a farm of 410 masks has 67650 POA frozen before the epoch opens.
